# task\-w06c\-read\-surfaces — W06c: read surfaces and exported worker tool contracts
status: todo  priority: 2  scope: scope-mcp
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

Expose the read model with the same contract on both surfaces: CLI snapshot \-\-json with \-\-if\-revision, snapshot detail with \-\-kind and \-\-id, snapshot thread with \-\-thread plus optional cursor and limit, snapshot history with \-\-task plus optional cursor and limit; MCP get\_ledger\_snapshot, get\_ledger\_record\_detail, get\_ledger\_thread\_page and get\_ledger\_task\_history\. Maintain one allowlisted contract catalog for worker tools and generate or export from it the schemas the plugin consumes, so no handwritten copy of a core schema exists\. The catalog identifies the caller\-identity fields \(agent, actor, from\_agent\) per operation so an adapter can bind them while preserving explicit recipients, successors, task IDs and evidence\-source inputs; generated wrapper schemas omit injected caller and context fields from model\-editable inputs\.

## Acceptance
- CLI and MCP read results are equivalent for the same ledger and inputs, including pagination and revision fields\.
- Exported schemas are generated from the catalog, a drift check fails when a generated schema and the catalog disagree, and no handwritten copy of a core schema exists in the plugin\.
- Every operation taking a caller\-identity field is marked in the catalog, and generated worker schemas omit those fields from model\-editable inputs\.
- No surface reimplements readiness, dependency rules or lifecycle truth\.
